messages:
daphne: opened PR 6066 — compact guide that shows KV-prefetch + dashboard cost/latency breakdown examples and how tracehook v2 maps to cost attribution. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6066
noah: i'll take a quick pass on snippets. which SDKs are in scope?
daphne: python, js, and a short CLI example. also one anchor looks stale in the cost section.
kai: pasted the python snippet here and ran locally:
```python
import os
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
res = client.prefetch.kv(prefix='user:', limit=25)
print([e['key'] for e in res['entries'][:5]])
```
kai: small nit: our py SDK surface returns objects not dicts in examples; change to `e.key` and add context management. i'll push a microfix.
daphne: thanks. js snippet currently uses callbacks, can we modernize to async/await and mention AbortSignal for long-running prefetches?
noah: will modernize. also link-bot flagged broken anchor /docs/console/costs#old-legend -> 404. suggested -> /docs/console/costs#legend-keys
link-bot: linkcheck: broken anchor /docs/console/costs#old-legend -> 404
vera: i tested the dashboard widget JSON in the PR; the field name for cost was still `usd_cost`  should be `cost_us`. changed locally and it fixed staging render. sending patch.
daphne: great. one paragraph about "latency shading" was ambiguous for SLO owners  can we add a prescriptive two-line checklist (canary batch ramp, 95th monitor threshold) before merging?
oah: suggested wording: "SLO owners: during canary, increase batch window in 3 steps (1x -> 2x -> 4x) for 15m each; abort if 95th latency > SLO + 10% for two consecutive windows." pushing that up.
kai: pushed python object change and added contextmanager example.
noah: pushed JS async rewrite and added AbortSignal snippet.
link-bot: re-check: all anchors resolved.
docs-bot: preview build passed for branch docs/pr-6066  warnings: 1 (image alt length). details: https://ci.redwood.ai/11678
daphne: anyone want to approve? hoping to merge before Friday docs cut.
kai: lgtm, approved.
vera: approved.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for docs-site (staging)  job 11699
daphne: merging now. created follow-up issue #980 to add a short "batching vs latency" mini-guide and to collect perf team feedback on the latency shading wording.
noah: will add a short snippet that shows how trace-key selection changes cost attribution for per-route rollups in that ticket.
